text: How many of those are whole-genome sequencing rather than RNA-Seq?

Abstract
The question asks for counts of whole-genome sequencing (WGS) versus RNA-Seq among a previously defined set (“those”), but the scope and source set are not specified. To produce correct counts, we must identify the exact cohort: the organism or study, repository (e.g., ENA/SRA, NCBI GEO), date range, and any filters that formed “those.” The appropriate data resources would be ENA/SRA (library_strategy field: WGS vs RNA-Seq), or NDE’s federated dataset index if the prior set came from a multi-repository search, and GEO for processed expression studies. Without the cohort definition, no valid numbers can be retrieved, and any count would be speculative. This clarification matters because library strategy labels and counts depend entirely on the filtered result set; ENA/SRA lists runs with controlled library_strategy values, GEO Series do not record WGS, and NDE counts can be scoped to the user’s earlier filters. Please specify the exact set so we can query and report the numbers with provenance.

I. Introduction
Background. Whole-genome sequencing and RNA-Seq are distinct library strategies commonly cataloged in ENA/SRA; GEO focuses on expression studies (RNA-Seq/microarray) rather than WGS.
Literature Review. No literature was retrieved for this query.
Knowledge Gap. The composition of “those” (organism, repository, filters, date range) is unknown.
Objective & Hypothesis. Objective: count WGS versus RNA-Seq among the user’s previously defined set. Hypothesis: counts will be determined by the library_strategy field within the exact cohort.

II. Materials and Methods
Study Design. Pending clarification: if the set is ENA/SRA runs, use ENA library_strategy; if the set is NDE results, facet measurementTechnique; if it is GEO, expect RNA-Seq-only with no WGS.
Materials. No database was queried pending scope clarification.
Procedures. No tool calls executed; awaiting cohort definition to run:
- ENA: brc_ena_search or brc_ena_runs with organism/taxid and filters; group by library_strategy.
- NDE: nde_facet_counts on measurementTechnique.name restricted to the prior query/repository.
- SRA: ncbi_sra_search with library strategy facets if applicable.
Statistical Analysis. Counts would be the number of records per library_strategy within the filtered set; denominator equals total records matching “those.”

III. Results
Data Presentation. No data were retrieved.
Findings. No counts can be reported without the definition of “those.”

IV. Discussion
Interpretation. No interpretation is possible without the cohort definition.
Context. ENA/SRA can distinguish WGS vs RNA-Seq via library_strategy; GEO does not catalog WGS.
Limitations. The query lacks the scope needed for reproducible counts (organism/repository/filters).
Conclusion & Future Directions. Provide the exact set: repository (ENA/SRA/NDE/GEO), organism/taxid, date range, and any filters that defined “those.” On receipt, we will run the appropriate tool calls and return WGS vs RNA-Seq counts with provenance.
